```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(splines)

pipe_data  <- read_csv("data/raw/pipes.csv")
train_data <- read_csv("data/raw/train.csv")

#table
net <- pipe_data %>%
  #cleaning up names, adding columns
  transmute(id = `Pipe ID`, Material = replace_na(Material, "wrought iron"),
            surface = Surface, x1 = `GPS x1`, y1 = `GPS y1`, x2 = `GPS x2`, y2 = `GPS y2`,
            lay_year = year(`Lay date`)) %>%
  mutate(len = sqrt((x1 - x2)^2 + (y1 - y2)^2),
         mid_x = (x1 + x2) / 2, mid_y = (y1 + y2) / 2,
         leaked = id %in% train_data$`Pipe ID`,
         iron   = str_detect(Material, "iron") & !leaked,
         lay_year = coalesce(lay_year,
         median(lay_year[Material == "wrought iron"], na.rm = TRUE)))

#leaked records with cost
leaks_all <- train_data %>% transmute(id = `Pipe ID`, Cost)


```

```{r stepwise from 452}

library(splines)
set.seed(1)

# pipes that could leak; y = 1 if leaked by the cutoff
d <- net %>%
  filter(Material != "polyurethane") %>%
  mutate(y   = as.integer(leaked), set = sample(1:2, n(), replace = TRUE))

n1 <- sum(d$set == 1)
n2 <- sum(d$set == 2)

#largest model we are willing to consider
full_formula <- y ~ Material + surface + ns(lay_year, 4) + log(len) + Material:surface

# First half of data

initial_1 <- glm(data = d[d$set == 1, ], formula = y ~ 1, family = binomial)
final_1 <- glm(data = d[d$set == 1, ], formula = full_formula, family = binomial)

step1 <- step(object = initial_1, scope = list(upper = final_1),k = log(n1))

# Second half of data

initial_2 <- glm(data = d[d$set == 2, ], formula = y ~ 1, family = binomial)
final_2   <- glm(data = d[d$set == 2, ], formula = full_formula, family = binomial)

step2 <- step(object = initial_2, scope = list(upper = final_2), k = log(n2)
)

#########backward#############
initial_1 <- glm(data = d[d$set == 1, ], formula = y ~ 1, family = binomial)
final_1   <- glm(data = d[d$set == 1, ], formula = full_formula, family = binomial)

forward1 <- step(object = initial_1, scope = list(upper = final_1),
                 direction = "forward", k = log(n1))

backward1 <- step(object = final_1, scope = list(lower = initial_1),
                  direction = "backward", k = log(n1))

#Second half of data

initial_2 <- glm(data = d[d$set == 2, ], formula = y ~ 1, family = binomial)
final_2   <- glm(data = d[d$set == 2, ], formula = full_formula, family = binomial)

forward2 <- step(object = initial_2, scope = list(upper = final_2), 
                 direction = "forward", k = log(n2))

backward2 <- step(object = final_2, scope = list(lower = initial_2), 
                  direction = "backward", k = log(n2))

# Compare what each one picked
formula(step1);     formula(step2)
formula(forward1);  formula(forward2)
formula(backward1); formula(backward2)

```

```{r}
priority_list <- function(net, leaks_all, type_weight = NULL, power = 1,
                          leaks_formula = y ~ Material + surface + ns(lay_year, 4) + log(len)) {
  
  #pipes that could ever leak (everything except polyurethane)
  possible_leak <- net %>% filter(Material != "polyurethane") %>%
    mutate(y = as.integer(leaked))
  
  #likelihood of leaking
  fit <- glm(leaks_formula, family = binomial, data = possible_leak)
  
  # cost of leak (if it leaks)
  sev <- leaks_all %>% left_join(select(net, id, surface, Material, len), by = "id")
  cost_fit <- glm(Cost ~ surface + Material + log(len), 
                  family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = sev)
  
  #pipes that haven't leaked yet
  open <- possible_leak %>% filter(!leaked)
  
  out <- open %>%
    mutate(p = predict(fit, open, type = "response"), 
           cost_if_leak = predict(cost_fit, open, type = "response"),
           exp_loss = p * cost_if_leak,
           loss_per_metre = exp_loss / len)
  
  #type of iron
  w <- rep(1, nrow(out))
  if (!is.null(type_weight)) {
    tw <- type_weight[out$Material]
    w  <- ifelse(is.na(tw), 1, tw)
  }
  
  #score: power = 1 is the old score (p * cost / len)
  #smaller power shrinks p toward constant
  out$score <- out$p^power * out$cost_if_leak / out$len * w
  
  out %>%
    arrange(desc(score)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    select(rank, id, iron, Material, surface, len, mid_x, mid_y, p, cost_if_leak,
           exp_loss, loss_per_metre, score)
}
```

```{r}
#what the two halves of the stepwise search picked
chosen <- formula(step1)
chosen
formula(step2)

#original formula and score
pl_old <- priority_list(net, leaks_all, power = 1)
pl_iron_old <- filter(pl_old, iron)

write_csv(pl_iron_old, "data/processed/priority_iron_old.csv")
write_csv(pl_old, "data/processed/priority_all_old.csv")

#stepwise formula and shrunk probability (power = 0.5)
pl_new <- priority_list(net, leaks_all, power = 0.5, leaks_formula = chosen)
pl_iron_new <- filter(pl_new, iron)

write_csv(pl_iron_new, "data/processed/priority_iron_stepwise.csv")
write_csv(pl_new, "data/processed/priority_all_stepwise.csv")

#sanity checks
nrow(pl_iron_old); nrow(pl_iron_new)

#how different are the two rankings?
top_n <- 1000
length(intersect(head(pl_iron_old$id, top_n), head(pl_iron_new$id, top_n))) / top_n
```
